request.title: The Mark of the Emissary
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: the Realm of Death and Shadow, a grey land of mist, dead trees and black water. Durzo stands with head thrown back as a mark burns violet-white on his neck, and behind him rises the towering spectral form of the Emissary of Death: a grim reaper of living shadow and violet flame with a great scythe. Awe and dread. Characters: Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Durzo. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: Durzo in the Realm of Death as a towering spectral grim reaper of shadow and violet fire rises behind him, a mark blazing on his neck.
